recent_sessions.summary: Voice-transcribed active translation baseline: simple negative and need-help sentences correct; several recalled words but recurring gaps in agree/task/run into, collocations and active construction. Scores not assigned because of transcription corrections.

study_plan.rationale: Based on 14 spoken vocabulary prompts, active word retrieval and common collocations need strengthening; transcript recognition was occasionally corrected by learner. Not a standardized level test.
study_plan.focus: high-frequency words -> collocation -> reusable sentence pattern -> retrieval

weeks.goal: retrieve target words without hints and build short correct sentences
use one key collocation for each newly learned word

weeks.focus: reusable everyday and engineering reporting patterns
weeks.goal: describe real actions with correct tense and word order
compare observed performance with baseline and choose next stage

study_plan.pacing: six training days plus one review-only day per week; decrease new words if next-day recall is weak
session_rules: do not reveal key English words before production attempt
distinguish speech recognition ambiguity from learner mistakes
study_plan.voice: optional; use spoken response in last 5 minutes when convenient, text accepted for accurate spelling and grammar
study_plan.completion_check: next-day unprompted recall, correct collocation and two independent sentences; not a promise of CEFR improvement
